items.problem: 202 nullability warnings (CS8600/CS8602/CS8612/CS8618/CS8625/CS8629) across the migrated .cs files; none are fatal and none affected the score.
items.evidence: Second failed build listed 52 such warnings (session-log 6239-6328); final green build reports '202 warning(s), 0 WUI analyzer warning(s)' (session-log 6844/7417). Score = 100.
items.covered_clearly_at: Not a migration-pattern concern: these come from the SDK-style project's default nullable context and are benign. The skill correctly does not require chasing nullable-reference warnings; Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 gates on WUI analyzer warnings (0), not CS86xx.
items.why_no_skill_change: Nullability warnings are non-fatal build noise unrelated to UWP->WinUI 3 API migration and did not affect build/run/parity. Teaching the skill to suppress them would add noise for zero score impact; a capable model correctly leaves them.
